question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank and complete the given idiom.

Although our backgrounds are different, we sail in the __________ boat.
solution:
The correct answer is '**same**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom "**we sail in the same boat**" means that we are in the same difficult situation or share similar circumstances. (हम एक ही स्थिति में हैं या समान परिस्थितियों का सामना कर रहे हैं।)
 
• The word "**same**" is the most appropriate choice to complete the idiom and make the sentence meaningful.
 
• The other options: "**different**," "**biggest**," and "**old**" do not fit the idiom or its meaning correctly.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *Although our backgrounds are different, we sail in the same__ boat.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Different (अलग)**: means not the same as another.
 
• **Biggest (सबसे बड़ा)**: means of the largest size or extent.
 
• **Old (पुराना)**: means belonging to the past or having existed for a long time.

30:Tce9,

The correct answer is: **Option 3 (Undiscovered)**.
